qa_pairs.question: What information is displayed on the left side of the "Mémoire GPU" graph?
qa_pairs.answer: The graph on the left side of the "Mémoire GPU" section shows the memory used by the GPU.

qa_pairs.question: What does the graph on the right side of the "Mémoire GPU" section represent?
qa_pairs.answer: The graph on the right side illustrates the percentage of cycles during which the GPU's memory interface is actively sending or receiving data.
